summary: Show checkpoint worker phases and participant blockers in status and doctor

replay.detail: Worker evidence is process-local display metadata; no replay changes.

schema.detail: Status adds an optional worker field; older status responses remain readable. No stored claim or database schema changes.

rules.detail: No change to participant selection, leave or excusal authority, checkpoint rules, proof or trim.

compatibility.detail: Text status and doctor name missing seals or verifications and report the local worker phase and failure. Status does not start capture or proof.

downtime.detail: Diagnostics appear after the normal binary rollout; this change does not restart any daemon.

manual.detail: Checkpoint enablement remains an explicit per-member configuration choice; no configuration is changed.

recovery.detail: No automatic excusal, checkpoint resume, deletion or recovery action is introduced.
